article.headline: Celtics, 76ers tied 1-1 heading into game 3
article.description: Boston Celtics (56-26, second in the Eastern Conference) vs. Philadelphia 76ers (45-37, seventh in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Celtics, 76ers tied 1-1 heading into game 3
article.story: Boston Celtics (56-26, second in the Eastern Conference) vs. Philadelphia 76ers (45-37, seventh in the Eastern Conference) Philadelphia; Friday, 7 p.m. EDT LINE: Celtics -7.5; over/under is 215.5 EASTERN CONFERENCE FIRST ROUND: Series tied 1-1 BOTTOM LINE: The Philadelphia 76ers and the Boston Celtics are in a 1-1 series tie in the Eastern Conference first round. The 76ers defeated the Celtics 111-97 in the last matchup on Tuesday. VJ Edgecombe led the 76ers with 30 points, and Jaylen Brown led the Celtics with 36. The 76ers are 9-7 against the rest of their division. Philadelphia ranks eighth in the Eastern Conference with 50.1 points per game in the paint led by Tyrese Maxey averaging 14.0. The Celtics are 10-6 against the rest of the division. Boston ranks third in the league averaging 15.5 made 3-pointers per game while shooting 36.7% from deep. Derrick White leads the team averaging 2.7 makes while shooting 32.7% from 3-point range. The 76ers make 46.2% of their shots from the field this season, which is 2.0 percentage points higher than the Celtics have allowed to their opponents (44.2%). The Celtics are shooting 46.7% from the field, which equals what the 76ers' opponents have shot this season. TOP PERFORMERS: Maxey is scoring 28.3 points per game with 4.1 rebounds and 6.6 assists for the 76ers. Paul George is averaging 19.2 points and 4.6 rebounds while shooting 47.5% over the past 10 games. Brown is averaging 28.7 points, 6.9 rebounds and 5.1 assists for the Celtics. Sam Hauser is averaging 2.7 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: 76ers: 5-5, averaging 110.7 points, 44.9 rebounds, 22.8 assists, 7.9 steals and 4.1 blocks per game while shooting 46.0% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 111.7 points per game. Celtics: 7-3, averaging 119.3 points, 45.8 rebounds, 26.9 assists, 6.7 steals and 4.3 blocks per game while shooting 49.0% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 108.5 points. INJURIES: 76ers: Joel Embiid: day to day (abdomen). Celtics: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.

articles.headline: How a trade 19 years ago is still helping OKC and its title hopes
articles.description: Little did anyone know on July 11, 2007, that a minor trade between the Seattle SuperSonics and the Orlando Magic would change NBA history.

images.caption: Victor Oladipo, Rashard Lewis, Kurt Thomas, Paul George, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander & Adam Silver
images.alt: Victor Oladipo, Rashard Lewis, Kurt Thomas, Paul George, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander & Adam Silver

images.name: Sonics (Rashard Lewis) [1399x2100]
images.caption: OKC's title run can be traced back to one date -- July 11, 2007 -- and one player: former Seattle SuperSonics forward Rashard Lewis.

images.name: Sonics (Kevin Durant) [1399x2100]
images.caption: One of Sam Presti's first decisions was an easy one: drafting Kevin Durant with the No. 2 pick in the 2008 NBA draft. The NBA is still feeling the ripple effects -- 19 years later.
images.credit: Jesse D. Garrabrant/NBAE via Getty Images

images.name: Sonics (Paul George) [2100x1400]
images.caption: Less than a year after Paul George had signed a four-year extension with the Thunder, OKC management received word: He wanted out. What came next would change the course of franchise history.

articles.headline: Nikola Jokic, Nuggets have night to forget in Game 3 blowout loss
articles.description: It was a night to forget for Nuggets star Nikola Jokic, who missed 19 of 26 shots in a blowout Game 3 loss that gave the Timberwolves a 2-1 series lead.

images.name: Nikola Jokic [600x400]
images.caption: Nikola Jokic scored 27 points but shot just 7-of-26 from the field, marking the first time in his career that he attempted at least 26 shots in a game and made only seven or fewer of them.

images.name: Rudy Gobert drains impressive and-1 over Jokic
